newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar prices fall on low seasonal buying.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar prices fall on low seasonal buying.

text.p: Indian sugar prices fell on Wednesday as seasonal buying for Tuesday's kite festival eased and on profit-taking, dealers said.
Sugar was up by 10/15 rupees per quintal on Tuesday.
Ready delivery S-30 sugar fell by 4/15 rupees to 1,250/1,291 rupees per quintal while M-30 fell by 10 rupees to 1,300/1,375 rupees.
Sugar mill delivery however extended gains on the back of limited offerings by the mill owners, rising from 1,195/1,205 rupees to 1,215/1,230 rupees.
